top_level_directories..test-orchestrator: Tracked state-aware test orchestration plan and repository-wide test selection contract.
top_level_directories.dashboard: Frontend React/Vite dashboard application, including UI source, frontend package manifest, and frontend build configuration.
top_level_directories.docs: Durable documentation, architecture notes, runbooks, project organization plans, and user-facing technical references.
top_level_directories.examples: Sanitized runnable examples and non-production reference integrations.
top_level_directories.packages: Private reusable packages and independently testable automation subpackages consumed by the host application.
top_level_directories.scripts: Repository automation, worker entry points, smoke checks, E2E wrappers, installation helpers, and release/deployment helpers.
top_level_directories.src: Canonical backend application source: API routes, auth, proxy, providers, database, runtime automation orchestration, and WebSocket server.
top_level_directories.tests: Repository-level automated tests and sanitized fixtures for backend, frontend logic, automation runtime, and integration behavior.
top_level_directories.runtime: Ignored local browser runtime assets. Not canonical source; may be copied into release artifacts only by an approved release script with manifest evidence.

policies.secrets_policy: Do not track or package .env, .env.* except .env.example, tokens, cookies, SQLite operational databases, or account credential artifacts.
policies.release_policy: Release artifacts must be generated from a verified commit. Exclude credentials, local databases, dependencies, test state, and editor state. runtime/ browser assets may be included only as scripted release assets with source, size, checksum, and verification recorded in the release manifest.
policies.synthetic_automation_policy: The old local synthetic automation lab UI/API is approved for later removal. Test-only simulation must live as test fixtures/adapters, not product UI or public runtime routes.
policies.postman_register_package_policy: packages/postman-register remains an independent private package. Host integration should prefer package-level exports or a narrow adapter over deep imports from many package internals.
